paragraphs: Nelnet Campus Commerce sells payment technology to higher education institutions for use online and on campus. One group of products handles the tuition payment process through Payment Plans, Billing & Payments, and Refunds. Another group covers Cashiering, Storefront, and Payment Forms.

The company states it has offered payment solutions for over 25 years to over 1,300 institutions. Products are described as integrating with systems already in place on campus. Stated aims include keeping students enrolled and on track while making staff more efficient.

Kansas City Kansas Community College is named as an institution that partnered with Nelnet Campus Commerce. A case study describes how College of the Mainland delayed payment plans for students after Hurricane Harvey. Another case study covers Cornell and student refunds.

quote.text: Online and on-campus payment technology built for every level of higher education.
